name: Ro60-0175
summary: Ro60-0175, or Ro-600175, also known as (S)-5-fluoro-6-chloro-α-methylisotryptamine ((S)-5-F-6-Cl-isoAMT), is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the isotryptamine family developed by Hoffmann–La Roche, which has applications in scientific research. It is the enantiopure (S)- isomer of the 5-fluoro and 6-chloro derivative of α-methylisotryptamine (isoAMT).
